subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should an explicit `supervision.enabled: false` continue to hide the Codex session catalog, and is `registerSessionCatalog` approved as a permanent public Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The PR changes the meaning of an existing user setting and creates a new shipped extension API; source review and tests cannot establish maintainer intent for those compatibility decisions.

options.title: Approve independent catalogs
options.body: Keep catalogs active independently of agent-facing supervision, document the changed setting semantics, and ship the public SDK after the technical blockers and live-proof gate are resolved.

options.title: Preserve the existing opt-out
options.body: Keep `supervision.enabled: false` authoritative for catalog visibility or introduce a separately approved catalog setting.

options.title: Keep registration internal
options.body: Narrow the seam to bundled plugins until maintainers are ready to support a permanent external session-catalog API.

recommendation.title: Approve independent catalogs
recommendation.body: Keep catalogs active independently of agent-facing supervision, document the changed setting semantics, and ship the public SDK after the technical blockers and live-proof gate are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current Codex and Claude catalog product surfaces and authored the linked product-direction issue.
